title: Nexus AgentHostProfile
description: Daemon-global agent profile selected in the browser path (I-000064). Persisted in the daemon home `config.toml` under the `agent_profile` table. Also the PUT request body for PUT /v1/daemon/agent-host/profile.

name.description: Agent name as reported by the agent-host scan (or the `custom` sentinel for a manual launch command). Blank names are rejected with `invalid_input`.

launch_command.description: Optional launch-command override for the selected agent.
